stageDefinitions.staticDetection: STAGE 1 (readonly, pre-reduction): public Scope Map ties an explicit task-exclusion intent record (category=intent, polarity=limits, exclusion detail) or a no-risk candidate classification to a prelabelled-unnecessary atom, matched by EXACT stable atom id. Static pre-analysis alone does not identify runtime redundancy; this rate is never advertised as >=80.
stageDefinitions.runtimeConfirmed: STAGE 2: a labelled-unnecessary atom whose removal was actually delivered in an artifact advertised verified AND fully independently re-proven (exact-base apply, producer tree match, whole-tree byte-level delta equal to ONLY the matched unnecessary edits across every tracked HEAD path and Git mode (missing/added/untracked files and mode flips included), oracle after each command with per-command tree identity, held-out oracle). Failed/unverified removals never count.
stageDefinitions.deletion: STAGE 3 (visibility only): fixtures with at least one labelled-unnecessary atom automatically removed, regardless of verification outcome. Never used as a detection gate.
stageDefinitions.fullPipelineDetection: GATE METRIC: per-case UNION of stage 1 and stage 2, deduplicated; denominator = ALL original labelled cases containing unnecessary edits, including conservative misses and failed cases.
